subject: planner: Set minimum cost to avoid parent multiplication cost discrepancies (#56387)
summary: Planner cost-model v2 change floors potentially negative components (row-size-derived scan/order terms and overall CostVer2.GetCost) to >= 0 via built-in max, preventing negative costs from propagating into plan-cost comparisons and tie-breaking.
